name: Ducati 125 / 175 / 200 Elite and Sport (early singles)
intro: Ducati's early bevel-drive singles that came before the wide-case 250s.

H: The bevel-drive cams are set with shims and need patience. Check the bevel gear backlash and the desmo shims before you run it hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
